internal.title: Incident Report: Checkout Service Error Rate Spike Due to Payment Service Error Injection
internal.body:
At 12:26 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis identified a high error rate in the payment service caused by an error injection flagged as 'paymentFailure'. This flag was set to 50%, coinciding with the spike in errors. The checkout service errors were traced back to this payment service failure, with no abnormal latency or resource exhaustion detected in either service.

Actions taken included disabling the 'paymentFailure' flag at 12:46 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery of the error rates to normal levels by 12:46:50 UTC. The frontend service showed no latency issues throughout the incident.

The incident was resolved by addressing the injected errors in the payment service, restoring normal operation for checkout and dependent services.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing issues
external.body: Between 12:26 and 12:47 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced failures when attempting to complete checkout. This was caused by an issue in the payment processing system. The problem was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service was restored by 12:47 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
